title: Dimension Loopback
description: Connect the overworld and end by making the boundary traversable!
body: This mod does nothing but make it so when you go 400 blocks into the sky, you enter the end. And if you fall into the void, you enter the overworld. This mod may be useful if, for example, you need to be able to clutch while falling in the end void. There are no plans to update this mod, it is just a mod idea I got.
